description: Causal inference for quasi-experiments in Python, with Bayesian (PyMC) and scikit-learn backends.
rules: Use `import causalpy as cp`. Experiments are top-level classes: `cp.DifferenceInDifferences`, `cp.InterruptedTimeSeries`, `cp.SyntheticControl`, `cp.RegressionDiscontinuity` and others.
The old `cp.pymc_experiments` and `cp.skl_experiments` modules no longer exist.
Pass a pandas DataFrame, a patsy `formula` and a `model` from `cp.pymc_models` (Bayesian) or a scikit-learn regressor; inspect results with `result.summary()` and `result.plot()`.
